disc.title: Information
disc.body: Pet Aura reveals your pet's world: its aura, horoscope and the energies of its space. It does not replace a veterinary examination – if you are worried about your pet, see a vet.
home.empty: Photograph your pet to reveal their aura
tip.red: The red in the background is rattling the root chakra. Swap it for something earthy, like a brown or green blanket.
tip.yellow: Lots of yellow, lots of sparkle. Keep a calm corner nearby so the energy can settle.
tip.green: Green is lifting the heart chakra. Keep a plant, or a green cushion, near the favourite nap spot.
tip.blue: Blue brings calm. A soft blue blanket in the north corner keeps it flowing.
tip.purple: Purple stirs the third eye. A tidy, quiet window spot suits this mood.
tip.neutral: A balanced backdrop. Try a green cushion in the north corner for a little extra grounding.
el.fire: Fire energy: bold and restless today. Plan a playful run to burn it off.
el.earth: Earth energy: steady and food-minded. A calm walk suits the day.
el.air: Air energy: curious and chatty. New smells and a puzzle toy will delight.
el.water: Water energy: soft and cuddly. Plenty of quiet time together.

fs.h.title: How do you measure the direction of the resting place?
fs.h.1t: Step into the heart of your home
fs.h.1: Stand near the middle of your home or the room, not right next to a wall or window.
fs.h.2: Hold the phone flat in front of you and turn toward your pet’s sleeping spot (your pet doesn’t need to be lying there now).
fs.h.3: Hold still for a moment, then tap “Use this”!
fs.h.tip: ✦ Tip: For an accurate measurement, keep your phone away from larger metal objects and electronic devices.

vm.h.title: What is the Magic Workshop?
vm.h.1: Look through the sample images and pick the world your little one would love to step into. The samples show the Pet Aura mascots. On the style page, use the “Cat” or “Dog” button to choose who the picture is for.
vm.h.2: Choose a photo where their sweet face and fur are clearly visible – it’s best if their whole little body is in the picture. Your little one is transformed in their own familiar pose, and their colors, markings and face stay recognizable.
vm.h.3: A few seconds, and your picture is ready. Every picture is unique: even the same photo gives a slightly different bit of magic each time, and with some styles, sharp photos turn out a little more lifelike.
vm.h.tip: ✦ The holiday style is only visible during the holidays, so check back!
vm.h.priv: ✦ We don’t keep your photo: it is used only to create the picture and is not stored afterwards.
vm.h.4: Use the buttons under the finished picture to save or share it with a single tap. A small Pet Aura mark will appear in its corner.
